title: Higher Resolution, Better Generalization: Unlocking Visual Scaling in Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.10546v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pixel-based deep reinforcement learning agents are typically trained on heavily downsampled visual observations, a convention inherited from early benchmarks rather than grounded in principled design. In this work, we show that observation resolution is a critical yet overlooked variable for policy learning: higher-resolution inputs can substantially improve both performance and generalization, provided the network architecture can process them effectively. We find that the widely used Impala encoder, which flattens spatial features into a vector, suffers from quadratic parameter growth as resolution increases and fails to leverage the additional visual detail. We test different modifications to the Impala architecture and conclude that, in particular, introducing a global average pooling layer, as in the Impoola architecture, yields consistent improvements across resolutions and network widths while decoupling parameter count from r

translated_title: 更高分辨率，更好泛化：解锁深度强化学习中的视觉缩放
translated_abstract: 基于像素的深度强化学习代理通常在严重降采样的视觉观察上训练，这一惯例继承自早期基准测试，而非基于原理性设计。在本工作中，我们表明观察分辨率是策略学习中一个关键但被忽视的变量：只要网络架构能有效处理，更高分辨率的输入可以显著提升性能和泛化能力。我们发现广泛使用的Impala编码器将空间特征展平为向量，随着分辨率增加导致参数数量二次增长，且无法利用额外的视觉细节。我们测试了Impala架构的不同修改，并得出结论，特别是引入全局平均池化层（如Impoola架构）能在不同分辨率和网络宽度下带来一致的改进，同时将参数数量与分辨率解耦。
tldr: 该论文发现提高观察分辨率能显著增强深度强化学习的性能和泛化能力，并提出Impoola架构通过全局平均池化有效利用高分辨率视觉信息，同时避免参数爆炸。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that increasing observation resolution significantly improves performance and generalization in deep reinforcement learning, and proposes the Impoola architecture with global average pooling to effectively leverage high-resolution visual information while avoiding parameter explosion.
